---
title: "World Flags Viewer"
format: html
resources:
  - flags/*.png
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(png)

files <- list.files("flags", pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", basename(files))

# Summarize a flag's color palette, spatial layout (12x18 grid), and shape
flag_features <- \(file) {
  img <- readPNG(file)
  d <- dim(img)
  rows <- round(seq(1, d[1], length.out = 12))
  cols <- round(seq(1, d[2], length.out = 18))

  rgb <- if (length(d) == 2) {
    rep(as.vector(img[rows, cols]), 3) |> matrix(ncol = 3)
  } else {
    img[rows, cols, 1:3] |> matrix(ncol = 3)
  }

  # Alpha mask for non-rectangular flag shapes (e.g., Nepal)
  alpha <- if (length(d) == 3 && d[3] == 4) {
    as.vector(img[rows, cols, 4])
  } else {
    rep(1, nrow(rgb))
  }

  # 64-bin RGB color histogram on visible pixels
  vis_rgb <- rgb[alpha > 0.5, , drop = FALSE]
  bins <- pmin(floor(vis_rgb * 4), 3)
  bucket <- bins[, 1] * 16 + bins[, 2] * 4 + bins[, 3] + 1
  color_hist <- tabulate(bucket, nbins = 64) / nrow(vis_rgb)

  # Combine layout (spatial RGB), color palette, and shape (aspect ratio + alpha mask)
  aspect <- (d[2] / d[1]) / 2
  c(as.vector(rgb * alpha) / 10, color_hist, alpha / 10, aspect)
}

features <- sapply(files, flag_features) |> t()
dist_mat <- dist(features) |> as.matrix()

# Find the 3 most similar (skipping identical territory duplicates) and 3 most different
similar_3 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dist_mat)), \(i) {
  row_d <- dist_mat[i, ]
  row_d[row_d == 0] <- Inf
  codes[order(row_d)[1:3]]
}) |> setNames(codes)

different_3 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dist_mat)), \(i) {
  row_d <- dist_mat[i, ]
  row_d[i] <- -Inf
  codes[order(row_d, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]]
}) |> setNames(codes)

ojs_define(
  codes = codes,
  similar = similar_3,
  different = different_3
)
```

```{ojs}
// Translate 2-letter ISO codes into full country names in the browser
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })
ukNames = ({
  "gb-eng": "England",
  "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland",
  "gb-sct": "Scotland",
  "gb-wls": "Wales"
})
labelFor = (code) => ukNames[code] ?? regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase()) ?? code

// Dropdown menu to choose a flag and toggle between similar/different
viewof selected = Inputs.select(codes, {
  label: "Select a country or region:",
  format: (code) => `${labelFor(code)} (${code})`,
  value: "us"
})

viewof mode = Inputs.radio(["Most similar", "Most different"], {
  label: "Show 3 flags that are:",
  value: "Most similar"
})

matches = mode === "Most similar" ? similar[selected] : different[selected]

// Display the selected flag and the 3 matching flags
html`<div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
  <h3>Selected: ${labelFor(selected)}</h3>
  <img
    src="flags/${selected}.png"
    alt="Flag of ${labelFor(selected)}"
    style="max-width: 320px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"
  />

  <h3 style="margin-top: 2rem;">3 ${mode} Flags (by color, shape, and layout)</h3>
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 1rem;">
    ${matches.map((code, i) => html`
      <div>
        <h4>#${i + 1}: ${labelFor(code)}</h4>
        <img
          src="flags/${code}.png"
          alt="Flag of ${labelFor(code)}"
          style="width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px;"
        />
      </div>
    `)}
  </div>
</div>`
```
